verdict.rationale: Cubic is fundamentally a review bot, not a coding agent that drives the git workflow: the only evidence of it touching git history is 'Fix with cubic' pushing a generated fix commit to an existing PR branch (cubic-docs-7). There is no evidence it stages arbitrary changes, writes original commit messages, creates new branches, or opens pull requests itself. Missing for 10: evidence of branch creation, PR opening, staged commits beyond auto-fixes, and commit message authoring.
